import datetime
import math
import re
import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return raw.select(
        supplier=pl.col("Vendor"),
        sku=pl.col("Item Code").str.to_uppercase(),
        description=pl.col("Item Name"),
        unit=pl.col("UOM").str.to_uppercase(),
        pack_size=pl.col("Pack").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False),
        price=pl.col("Unit Price")
        .str.replace_all(r"[^\d.]", "")
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
        currency=pl.lit("NZD"),
        valid_from=pl.col("Effective").str.to_date("%Y-%m-%d", strict=False),
    )
